worldcombat.skill.crushclaw.summary: Step forward, catch the first foe in front, and tear outward with a chance to expose its armor. An already exposed guard tears more deeply. Bodies and walls can block the claw.
You step in %1$s blocks and the claw reaches the first contact with a %2$s block half-width; only a non-ally living first contact takes the damage.

Has a %1$s chance to tear armor, lowering Defense by %2$s stages, plus %3$s against an already exposed guard. The tear lasts %4$s; another tear deepens it and refreshes its duration. The loss ends when the tear expires or is dispelled.
worldcombat.skill.crushclaw.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.crushclaw.growth.0: From level %1$s the slash rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.crushclaw.growth.1: From level %1$s the tear chance rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.crushclaw.use.0: Tear armour open with one reaching claw
worldcombat.skill.crushclaw.use.1: Rip a crack someone else already opened
worldcombat.skill.crushclaw.use.2: Trade one mid-range blow for a Defence drop
worldcombat.skill.crushclaw.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of tearing. Larger values open with the claw from further out.
On: prefer targets already carrying the guardbroken identity from any source, deepening the drop by a stage. Off: treat it as an ordinary mid-range slash.
